d: Jon Favreau, Jon Lovett, Dan Pfeiffer and Tommy Vietor from Pod Save America talk about feeling very optimistic about the midterm election results, being in the Obama White House during the 2010 midterms when things went very badly, who from the Trump administration might get fired, the possibility that Trump gets even crazier in his last two years, what Democrats should do now that they will have more power in Washington, whether or not Trump will question the results of the election, The Cheesecake Factory joke in Obama’s recent speech, who might decide to run for President, JD Vance…
